lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cd4Sb2Te6 (reduced formula Cd2SbTe3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral environments for all three elements: Cd centers coordinate to six Te neighbors, Sb centers coordinate to six Te neighbors, and Te centers coordinate to three Cd and three Sb neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cd and Sb octahedra, as well as edge-sharing among like octahedra.
